title: Collective Hysteresis and Multistability in Threshold Networks
summary: In a mechanistic model of the dawn chorus, Kaye showed that heterogeneous activation thresholds and a shared feedback signal determined by the population's active fraction can produce abrupt collective activation and hysteresis. We extend this mechanism to a network of interacting agents. Each node has a continuous activation level, and a nonnegative row-stochastic matrix determines how node activities contribute to individual feedback.
